title: SWE-Synth: Synthesizing Verifiable Bug-Fix Data to Enable Large Language Models in Resolving Real-World Bugs
authors_zh: Minh V. T. Pham, Huy N. Phan, Hoang Nhat Phan, Cuong Chi Le, Tien N. Nguyen, Nghi D. Q. Bui
paper_type_zh: 带可执行测试与修复轨迹的合成仓库级缺陷修复数据集
best_for_zh: 需要缺陷修复训练数据、可执行单测验证或修复轨迹的研究者。
one_line: SWE-Synth turns repository components into test-verifiable synthetic bugs and retains successful agent repair trajectories as bug-fix training data.
SWE-Synth 把仓库组件改写为可测试的合成缺陷，并保留通过测试的 agent 修复轨迹，形成可验证的缺陷修复训练数据。
why: It preserves test-validated repair outcomes and intermediate repair actions, not just static before/after diffs.
inclusion_reason: SWE-Synth releases repair examples with executable failure/preservation tests and accepted repair outcomes, giving code repair a replayable programmatic outcome signal.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Repository-level repair models need complete trajectories for localization, test-log reading, code editing, and patch verification, but real issues are limited and successful agent traces are even scarcer. A bug–fix diff alone does not supervise intermediate tool use. Random code mutation scales easily but often creates non-compiling, untested, or trivial defects.

SWE-Synth asks an LLM to reimplement functions in real repositories to create executable bugs, then lets a software-engineering agent iteratively repair them using failing logs and local code. Construction retains buggy repositories, failing and passing tests, candidate patches, and structured repair trajectories. Only agent outputs verified by tests enter the training set, yielding repository-level, process-aware, and executable data.

仓库级自动修复模型需要能定位故障、读取测试日志、编辑代码并验证补丁的完整轨迹，但真实 issue 数据数量有限，成功 agent 轨迹更少；仅有 bug–fix diff 又无法监督中间工具使用。直接随机变异代码虽然易扩展，却可能产生无法编译、没有测试触发或过于简单的缺陷。

SWE-Synth 用 LLM 重新实现真实仓库中的函数来制造可执行 bug，再让软件工程 agent 在失败日志和局部仓库中迭代修复。构建过程同时保存 buggy repository、失败/通过测试、候选补丁和结构化 repair trajectory；只有测试验证成功的 agent 输出进入训练集，从而产生仓库级、过程感知且可验证的数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is a single executable loop for both defect synthesis and repair-trajectory synthesis. Across multiple commits from seven Python repositories, the authors select test-covered functions and ask Qwen2.5-Coder-32B to reimplement them after removing their bodies. Versions that compile but make at least one test fail become bugs. The paper reports 9,459 buggy variants and 3,018 test-passing repair patches produced by agents; the visible Hugging Face snapshot may be smaller, so users should pin revisions. Training records can include repository states, test logs, tool interactions, patches, and verifier results for SWE-agent SFT, process distillation, and test-based rewards.

核心贡献是将“缺陷合成”和“修复轨迹合成”放在同一可执行闭环。作者从 7 个 Python 仓库的多个 commit 选择被测试覆盖的函数，让 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 在移除函数体后重新实现；编译成功但使至少一个测试失败的版本成为 bug。论文报告 9,459 个 buggy variants，并由 agent 获得 3,018 个测试通过的修复补丁；公开 Hugging Face 快照的可见规模可能较小，使用时应以 revision 为准。每条训练记录可包含仓库状态、测试日志、工具交互、补丁与 verifier 结果，适用于 SWE agent SFT、过程蒸馏和测试奖励。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select repositories and targets: Build environments for stable commits from seven Python projects and use coverage tracing to locate functions or classes executed by tests.
  1. Synthesize faulty implementations: Remove a target body and ask Qwen2.5-Coder-32B to reimplement it from context. Reinsert the output, discard syntax or compilation failures and versions that still pass all tests, and retain bugs that fail at least one test.
  1. Run a repair agent: Give MoatlessTool the repository, failing tests, and truncated logs. Qwen2.5-Coder-32B performs multi-round localization and editing with deterministic and stochastic attempts.
  1. Verify and store: Apply candidate patches and run associated tests. Only trajectories passing all relevant tests enter the successful set, while failed processes can also be retained. Reproduction requires fixed commits, test selection, log truncation, sampling rounds, and containers.

1. 选择仓库与目标： 从 7 个 Python 项目的多个稳定 commit 建立环境，用 coverage tracing 找出被测试执行的函数或类。
  1. 合成错误实现： 删除目标函数体，要求 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 根据上下文重新实现；将输出嵌回仓库，丢弃语法/编译失败和仍通过全部测试的版本，只保留至少一个测试失败的 bug。
  1. 运行修复 agent： 向 MoatlessTool 提供仓库、失败测试和截断日志，使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 多轮定位与编辑；每个任务进行确定性和随机采样尝试。
  1. 验证并保存： 应用候选补丁并执行相关测试，只有全部关联测试通过的轨迹进入成功集，同时保存失败过程。复现需固定 commit、测试选择、日志截断、采样轮数和容器。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors fine-tune a 32B model on 2,136 successful trajectories and compare it with similarly sized real repair data on SWE-bench. The SWE-Synth-trained model reaches 22.2% on SWE-bench Verified, versus 18.2% for the real-data model and 16.4% for the base model. On SWE-bench Lite it reaches about 24.33%, compared with 23.67% for real data. The abstract reports an overall Lite advantage of about 2.3 points under another configuration, so exact differences depend on the subset and setup. Results show transfer from synthetic verified trajectories, but sample counts, successful-task difficulty, and configurations are not uniformly controlled; the small Lite gap does not prove synthetic data is generally superior to real issues.

作者用 2,136 条成功轨迹微调 32B 模型，并在真实 SWE-bench 上与相同规模的人工修复数据比较。SWE-Synth 训练模型在 SWE-bench Verified 达到 22.2%，人工数据版本为 18.2%，未训练 base 为 16.4%；在 SWE-bench Lite 上约 24.33%，比人工数据 23.67% 高 0.66 点。摘要报告在 Lite 的总体优势约 2.3 点，具体差值随训练子集和设置变化。结果说明合成可验证轨迹能迁移，但样本量、成功任务难度和训练配置并非所有比较都完全一致，且收益在 Lite 上较小，不能据此断言合成数据普遍优于真实 issue。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Traditional mutation datasets store before–after code and test outcomes, while SWE-bench-style real data stores issues and gold patches but few successful interaction traces. SWE-Synth has an LLM rewrite complete functions to create contextually plausible but behaviorally wrong implementations, then immediately asks an agent to repair them using real test logs. Synthetic defect, tool process, and terminal verification are bound into one record. It is not the first use of tests for patch filtering or the first bug generator; the change is making process-aware trajectories the main training object and verifying both defect and repair in one repository test loop.

传统 mutation 数据只保存变异前后代码和测试结果，SWE-bench 类真实数据则保存 issue 与 gold patch，通常缺少大量成功交互轨迹。SWE-Synth 的变化是用 LLM 重写完整函数制造“上下文合理但行为错误”的 bug，并立即让 agent 通过真实测试日志修复，把合成缺陷、工具过程和终局验证绑定在一条记录中。它不是首次用测试过滤补丁，也不是首次生成 bug，而是将 process-aware trajectory 作为主要训练对象，并通过同一仓库测试闭环同时验证 defect 与 repair。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Narrow repository scope: The paper uses only seven Python projects, limiting code styles, test frameworks, and dependencies. Function rewrites differ from cross-module configuration, concurrency, or requirement defects. Evaluation should hold out repositories and align synthetic defects with real issue types.
  1. Successful-trajectory bias: Only bugs the agent can solve enter positive SFT, favoring easy-to-localize tasks with clear tests. Difficult signals disappear if failures are ignored. Solve rates by defect type and trajectory budgets per task should be reported.
  1. Test adequacy: Passing associated tests may overfit a local suite; without full P2P or hidden tests, regressive patches can remain. Reuse should rerun the full suite and distinguish the paper’s 9,459/3,018 statistics from the actual row count of a public snapshot.

1. 仓库范围窄： 论文只使用 7 个 Python 项目，代码风格、测试框架和依赖分布有限；按函数重写产生的错误可能不同于跨模块配置、并发或需求缺陷。应按仓库留出并与真实 issue 类型对齐分析。
  1. 成功轨迹选择偏置： 只有 agent 已能解决的 bug 进入正向 SFT，数据会偏向容易定位和测试明确的实例，失败轨迹若未利用则丢失困难信号。需报告每类 bug 的解决率和每题轨迹上限。
  1. 测试充分性： 通过关联测试可能只是过拟合局部套件，缺少全量 P2P 或隐藏测试会保留回归补丁。复用时应重跑完整 suite，并区分论文 9,459/3,018 统计与公开快照的实际行数。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Repair-trajectory SFT: Train coding agents from repository states, test logs, search and edit actions, and final patches. Split by repository and separately evaluate localization, patch application, and full-suite success.
  1. Process-reward research: Turn test changes or error logs after tool calls into step-level feedback and compare success-only training with mixtures including failed trajectories. Independent tests must remain the terminal oracle.
  1. Pipeline transfer: Reuse coverage localization, function rewriting, failure confirmation, agent repair, and execution acceptance on Python projects with stable tests. Repositories without tests, defects requiring external services, or requirement-level changes cannot provide reliable verification through this pipeline.

1. 修复轨迹 SFT： 使用仓库状态、测试日志、检索/编辑动作和最终补丁训练 coding agent；按仓库划分，并分别评估定位、补丁应用与全量测试通过。
  1. 过程奖励研究： 将每次工具调用后的测试变化或错误日志构造成 step-level feedback，比较只用成功轨迹与加入失败轨迹的效果；终局仍以独立测试为准。
  1. 合成流程迁移： 在有稳定测试的 Python 项目中复用“覆盖定位—函数重写—失败确认—agent 修复—执行验收”。若仓库缺少测试、缺陷需要外部服务或主要是需求级变化，该流程不能产生可靠 verifier。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SWE-Synth jointly synthesizes repository bugs and verified repair trajectories, reporting 9,459 faulty variants and 3,018 successful patches.
  1. Method takeaway: Coverage-based target selection, LLM reimplementation, failing-test filtering, multi-round agent repair, and terminal tests form the loop.
  1. Data takeaway: Records may include repositories, logs, actions, patches, and test results; public snapshot size must be checked by revision rather than copied from the paper.
  1. Evidence anchor: The 32B model reaches 22.2% on Verified, above 18.2% for real data and 16.4% for the base; the Lite advantage is smaller.
  1. Reuse decision: It fits process-aware SWE training. Success bias and local-test overfitting require failed trajectories and full hidden regression tests.

1. 一句话定位： SWE-Synth 同时合成仓库级 bug 和可验证修复轨迹，论文报告 9,459 个错误版本与 3,018 个成功补丁。
  1. 方法抓手： coverage 选函数、LLM 重实现、失败测试筛选、agent 多轮修复和测试终验构成闭环。
  1. 数据抓手： 记录可包含 repo、日志、动作、patch 与测试结果；公开快照规模需按 revision 核验，不能直接套用论文数字。
  1. 证据锚点： 32B 模型在 Verified 为 22.2%，高于人工数据 18.2% 和 base 16.4%；Lite 优势较小。
  1. 复用决定： 适合过程感知 SWE 训练；最大风险是成功偏置和局部测试过拟合，必须保留失败轨迹并运行全量隐藏测试。
